overview: The Medford Community Preservation Committee reviewed 2022 eligibility determination forms for upcoming project proposals and received status updates on active Community Preservation Act projects.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: The committee approved the meeting minutes for May 10, June 14, June 21, and July 26, 2022.

items.title: Review of 2022 Eligibility Determination Forms
items.summary: The committee reviewed preliminary eligibility forms for various historic preservation, open space, and affordable housing proposals, and discussed potential bonding strategies for large-scale requests.

items.title: CPA Project Updates
items.summary: Staff and members reviewed progress, procurement timelines, and administrative needs for active CPA-funded projects across the city.
